name: n8n 7 Data Operations Layer
purpose: Use n8n as the workflow operations bus for seven high-value data lanes feeding Player 2.

orchestrator.safe_boundary: no secrets in repo; credentials stay in n8n credential vault or local environment variables

data_lanes.source: GitHub official API or gh CLI
data_lanes.destination: player2_skill_factory SQLite backend and evidence manifests
data_lanes.player2_use: Generate skills, detect repo gaps, build next development task

data_lanes.destination: local evidence folder and resource score engine
data_lanes.player2_use: Route workloads to the right compute lane without guessing

data_lanes.source: workspace logs, generated outputs, proof manifests
data_lanes.player2_use: Learning loop, bug ranking, proof gates
Convert algorithmic scoring concepts into operations priority scoring

data_lanes.source: user-provided portfolio docs, task logs, approved local files
data_lanes.player2_use: Turn real-estate work into executable next actions

data_lanes.source: user-provided legal docs, docket notes, attorney task logs
data_lanes.player2_use: Organize case operations, deadlines, and evidence without making legal claims

data_lanes.source: official APIs, exports, or user-provided data only
data_lanes.destination: content task queue and strategy notes
data_lanes.trigger: manual, scheduled, or approved API event
data_lanes.player2_use: Create content and outreach tasks from approved signal data

n8n_workflow_template.dispatch_policy: Only workspace-safe or human-approved actions can execute automatically
